_comment: Captured baseline numbers for the benchmark harness. Update this file whenever the runtime characteristics change in an expected way (e.g. switching to a faster hash, or adopting a more compact SQLite schema). The values here are reference points used by the README to set realistic expectations — they are *not* enforced thresholds (see benchmarks/run_benchmarks.py for hard ceilings). Numbers were captured on an Apple M-series machine running Python 3.12, default FuseConfig. Run `python benchmarks/run_benchmarks.py --samples 5 --json` and overwrite this file to refresh. Format: median per-call microseconds.
